title: Occupancy and Residency Certification: Closing Interval by Scheduled Monthly Payments
content:
The **closing interval** by which scheduled contacts are counted for the closing contact of a health-care absence on an Occupancy and Residency Certification profile is read from the monitored Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) loan's transaction history — its scheduled monthly payments dated on or before the handling date and less than three whole calendar months before it:

| Scheduled monthly payments disbursed in that period | Closing interval |
|---|---|
| three or more | 30 calendar days |
| one or two | 60 calendar days |
| none | the plan's interval between contacts during a health-care absence — 90 calendar days under every plan |

A profile monitoring no HECM loan has no such payments. Whole calendar months are counted as anniversaries of the day number.
